sloka: ततः स शैलेन्द्रनिपातभग्नो महोदरस्तेन महाद्विपेन।विपोथितो भूमितले गतासुः पपात वज्राभिहतो यथा ऽद्रिः ।। ६.७०.३२ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa śailendranipātabhagno mahodarastena mahādvipena।vipothito bhūmitale gatāsuḥ papāta vajrābhihato yathā 'driḥ ।। 6.70.32 ।।

translations.english: Then smashed by the impact of the mountain, along with his elephant Mahodara's body fell to the ground. Released from life, he fell like a mountain struck with lightning.
